escena: SCENE (a press conference lectern, seen straight on at lectern height, in a dark hall): the lectern is NOT a wooden podium — its whole front face is a single long horizontal SEARCH BAR, a rounded rectangular slot lit softly from within, completely EMPTY except for one thin vertical text cursor standing at its left end. The bar is NOT blown out: it holds a visible gradient across its length, brighter at the left near the cursor and falling off towards the right, and its inner surface keeps a faint matte texture — never a flat white blank. No letters, no numbers, no words, no icons anywhere in it. Standing behind the lectern, only its upper half visible above the bar, the small Codex figure from the reference faces front, addressing the room. FOUR fat foam press microphones on long stems crowd in from the extreme LEFT and RIGHT edges only, angled up towards the figure; they are visibly LARGER than the figure's head. CRITICAL: the central third of the glowing bar is completely UNOBSTRUCTED — no microphone, no stem and no cable crosses in front of it, so the bar reads clean end to end. The hall behind is empty and falls to black: no audience, no seats, no banners, no windows. The glowing bar is the ONLY light source, throwing hard light upward onto the underside of the figure and onto the nearest microphone heads, while everything above and behind drops into deep navy darkness. Fine dust hangs in the beam. 50mm lens at f/2.8, camera at bar height. FRAMING FOR THIS FORMAT: the lectern sits LOW in the frame, its glowing bar near the bottom third; the empty dark hall rises tall and unbroken above it for most of the frame height. The four microphones crowd in from the bottom left and bottom right, angled steeply up. SIGNATURE BAND (essential): a horizontal band running the FULL width of the frame between 54% and 66% of the frame height is completely EMPTY, unlit and evenly dark — no object, no edge, no highlight, no light beam and no part of the subject enters it, and no bright surface sits behind it. It keeps faint material texture and is never a flat pure-black panel. Everything in the scene sits either ABOVE or BELOW that band.

texto.muro: the empty dark hall above the lectern, unbroken and unlit

lecho.objeto: a black flight case standing in the immediate foreground, running unbroken across the whole width of the frame below the microphones
lecho.tono: matte black textured road-case shell in full shadow, outside the light
